title: exalt — snatch

sentences.sentence: But it can also inspire and uplift and exalt, because power can be used to help people accomplish marvelous things.
sentences.translation: 但是，权力也可以激励人、振奋人和提升人，因为它可以帮助人们成就非同寻常的事业。

sentences.sentence: Soak the clothes in cold water.
sentences.translation: 把衣服浸泡在冷水里。

sentences.sentence: Let the pans soak; I’ll wash them later.
sentences.translation: 把锅泡着吧，我过一会儿再洗。

translations.translation: 浸没, 淹没, 掩没

sentences.sentence: The tunnel entrance was submerged by rising sea water.
sentences.translation: 隧道入口被涨起的海水淹没。

sentences.sentence: I like to macerate the food in liqueur for a few minutes before serving.
sentences.translation: 我想把食物在利口酒里泡几分钟后再享用。

sentences.sentence: She soaked bread in milk.
sentences.translation: 她把面包浸在牛奶里。

sentences.sentence: She's soaked to the skin in the rain.
sentences.translation: 在大雨中，她浑身都湿透了。

sentences.sentence: Brave but foolish, he was soaked by the explosion of water.
sentences.translation: 勇敢而愚蠢，他将自己浸泡在水的爆炸声中。

sentences.sentence: Three countries abstained in the vote.
sentences.translation: 三个国家在投票中弃权了。

sentences.sentence: The way we kill animals appals a lot of people.
sentences.translation: 我们屠杀动物的方式令许多人震惊。

sentences.sentence: The decision to execute the two men has appalled many politicians.
sentences.translation: 处死那两名男子的判决令许多从政者震惊。

translations.translation: 拘留, 留住, 阻止

sentences.sentence: Two suspects have been detained by the police for questioning .
sentences.translation: 两名嫌疑人被警方拘留审问。

sentences.sentence: She was detained in hospital with a suspected broken leg.
sentences.translation: 她因腿部疑似骨折而被留医。

sentences.sentence: Hines slowly masticated a shrimp.
sentences.translation: 海恩斯慢慢地咀嚼着一只虾。

sentences.sentence: Michael’s shoulders heaved with silent laughter.
sentences.translation: 迈克尔憋着不笑出声来，双肩直抖。

translations.translation: 拒绝, 排斥, 反驳, 击退, 憎恶

sentences.sentence: Government troops repulsed an attack by rebel forces.
sentences.translation: 政府军击退了叛军的攻击。

sentences.sentence: The two rivers converge into one near Pittsburgh.
sentences.translation: 这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

sentences.sentence: Crowds began to congregate to hear the President’s speech.
sentences.translation: 人群开始聚拢，来聆听总统的演讲。

translations.translation: 捐款, 订阅, 签署(文件), 赞成, 预订

sentences.sentence: I've personally never subscribed to the view that either sex is superior to the other.
sentences.translation: 我个人从未持有过一种性别比另一种性别优越的观点。

sentences.sentence: Farmers still sometimes unearth human bones here.
sentences.translation: 农民们有时仍然能在这里挖到人骨。

sentences.sentence: In one shop, I unearthed a wonderful collection of 1920s toys.
sentences.translation: 在一家商店，我发现了一套非常好玩的 20 世纪 20 年代的玩具。

sentences.sentence: The bones were disinterred and moved to a burial site.
sentences.translation: 骨头被掘出并移到了一片墓地。

sentences.sentence: The thief snatched her purse and ran.
sentences.translation: 小偷抢了她的钱包就跑。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 311 单元

exalt
音标：英 /ɪg'zɔːlt; eg-/  美 /ɪɡ'zɔlt/
v. 晋升
例句：But it can also inspire and uplift and exalt, because power can be used to help people accomplish marvelous things.
但是，权力也可以激励人、振奋人和提升人，因为它可以帮助人们成就非同寻常的事业。

soak
音标：英 /səʊk/  美 /sok/
v. 浸, 泡, 浸透
短语：soak in — 吸收；被深刻领会
短语：soak up — v. 吸收
短语：soak time — 浸泡时间
短语：soak into — v. 渗透入
短语：soak up the sun — v. 沐日光浴
短语：soak out — v. 浸泡出
例句：Soak the clothes in cold water.
把衣服浸泡在冷水里。
例句：Let the pans soak; I’ll wash them later.
把锅泡着吧，我过一会儿再洗。

submerge
音标：英 /səb'mɜːdʒ/  美 /səb'mɝdʒ/
v. 浸没, 淹没, 掩没
例句：The tunnel entrance was submerged by rising sea water.
隧道入口被涨起的海水淹没。

macerate
音标：英 /'mæsəreɪt/
v. 浸软
例句：I like to macerate the food in liqueur for a few minutes before serving.
我想把食物在利口酒里泡几分钟后再享用。

soaked
音标：英 /səʊkt/  美 /sokt/
v. 浸湿
短语：soak in — 吸收；被深刻领会
短语：soak up — v. 吸收
短语：soak time — 浸泡时间
短语：soak into — v. 渗透入
短语：soak up the sun — v. 沐日光浴
短语：soak out — v. 浸泡出
例句：She soaked bread in milk.
她把面包浸在牛奶里。
例句：She's soaked to the skin in the rain.
在大雨中，她浑身都湿透了。
例句：Brave but foolish, he was soaked by the explosion of water.
勇敢而愚蠢，他将自己浸泡在水的爆炸声中。

imbue
音标：英 /ɪm'bjuː/  美 /ɪm'bjʊ/
v. 浸透

abstain
音标：英 /əb'steɪn/  美 /əb'sten/
v. 禁绝, 放弃
短语：abstain from — 放弃；戒绝
短语：abstain from voting — 放弃表决，投票时弃权
例句：Three countries abstained in the vote.
三个国家在投票中弃权了。

appal
音标：英 /ə'pɔːl/  美 /ə'pɔl/
v. 惊骇
例句：The way we kill animals appals a lot of people.
我们屠杀动物的方式令许多人震惊。
例句：The decision to execute the two men has appalled many politicians.
处死那两名男子的判决令许多从政者震惊。

detain
音标：英 /dɪ'teɪn/  美 /dɪ'ten/
v. 拘留, 留住, 阻止
例句：Two suspects have been detained by the police for questioning .
两名嫌疑人被警方拘留审问。
例句：She was detained in hospital with a suspected broken leg.
她因腿部疑似骨折而被留医。

masticate
音标：英 /'mæstɪkeɪt/  美 /'mæstikeit/
v. 咀嚼
例句：Hines slowly masticated a shrimp.
海恩斯慢慢地咀嚼着一只虾。

daunt
音标：英 /dɔːnt/  美 /dɔ:nt/
v. 沮丧

heave
音标：英 /hiːv/  美 /hiv/
v. 举起
短语：frost heave — 冻胀
短语：heave a sigh — 叹了口气
例句：Michael’s shoulders heaved with silent laughter.
迈克尔憋着不笑出声来，双肩直抖。

repulse
音标：英 /rɪ'pʌls/  美 /rɪ'pʌls/
v. 拒绝, 排斥, 反驳, 击退, 憎恶
短语：repulse bay — 浅水湾
例句：Government troops repulsed an attack by rebel forces.
政府军击退了叛军的攻击。

converge
音标：英 /kən'vɜːdʒ/  美 /kən'vɝdʒ/
v. 聚合, 集中于一点
例句：The two rivers converge into one near Pittsburgh.
这两条河在匹兹堡附近汇合。

congregate
音标：英 /'kɒŋgrɪgeɪt/  美 /'kɑŋɡrɪɡet/
v. 聚集
例句：Crowds began to congregate to hear the President’s speech.
人群开始聚拢，来聆听总统的演讲。

conglomerate
音标：英 /kən'glɒm(ə)rət/  美 /kən'ɡlɑːmərət/
v. 聚结
短语：conglomerate reservoir — 砾岩储集层

subscribe
音标：英 /səb'skraɪb/  美 /səb'skraɪb/
v. 捐款, 订阅, 签署(文件), 赞成, 预订
例句：I've personally never subscribed to the view that either sex is superior to the other.
我个人从未持有过一种性别比另一种性别优越的观点。

unearth
音标：英 /ʌn'ɜːθ/  美 /ʌn'ɝθ/
v. 掘出
例句：Farmers still sometimes unearth human bones here.
农民们有时仍然能在这里挖到人骨。
例句：In one shop, I unearthed a wonderful collection of 1920s toys.
在一家商店，我发现了一套非常好玩的 20 世纪 20 年代的玩具。

disinter
音标：英 /,dɪsɪn'tɜː/  美 /,dɪsɪn'tɝ/
v. 掘出
例句：The bones were disinterred and moved to a burial site.
骨头被掘出并移到了一片墓地。

snatch
音标：英 /snætʃ/  美 /snætʃ/
v. 攫取
短语：snatch at — 抓取
例句：The thief snatched her purse and ran.
小偷抢了她的钱包就跑。
